about: Curated stops for the Great Lakes legs (missing roads pass, 2026-11-22), placed by cargo tools osm-stops --stops. Started from the stops the region's existing legs carry with a position and a source, so a stop on a shared road lands on a new leg too; heading for those was derived from the side the old leg placed them on. lat, lon, reach_mi, season and heading steer placement; every other key is the stop as the game reads it. A stop with a heading lands on a leg stored the other way with directions reverse.
